use ravenrs_widgets::{Badge, Footer, Tone};

It holds nothing: the app gives it what is there and where the playhead is,
and gets back what people do. Blocks are buttons, so they work with the
keyboard. Dragging the ruler moves the playhead, dragging a
[movable](TimelineItem::movable) block moves it, and the ends of a
[trimmable](TimelineItem::trimmable) one change its length.

```
use ravenrs_widgets::{Timeline, TimelineItem, TimelineTrack, Tone};

let timeline = Timeline::new(vec![
    TimelineTrack::new("Notes", 34.0, vec![TimelineItem::new(1, 2_000, 3_000, "Callout").movable()]),
    TimelineTrack::new("Film", 56.0, vec![TimelineItem::new(2, 0, 10_000, "Take 1").tone(Tone::Accent)]),
])
.position_ms(4_000)
.on_seek(|ms| println!("{ms}"));
```

what is going on in the background, a notice with its actions.

status bar keeps one fixed line: its sides keep their width and the center
takes the rest, cutting what does not fit, so it never pushes the app around.
Tinting the center with [`Self::center_tone`] makes a notice stand out without
the whole bar shouting. The center is announced to screen readers as a status.

```
use ravenrs_widgets::{StatusBar, Tone, ViewExt};

let bar = StatusBar::new()
    .left((StatusBar::action("Version 1.2"),))
    .center((StatusBar::text("Version 1.3 is available").truncate().grow(1.0), StatusBar::action("Update")))
    .center_tone(Tone::Warning)
    .right((StatusBar::text("12 items"),));
```

10235.name: ravenrs_widgets
10235.docs:
Declarative views and the UI runtime.

# Writing components

There are three ways to make your own component, from simplest to most powerful:

1. **A function** returning `impl View`, composing existing views. Good for
   stateless pieces of UI.
2. **A [`Component`]**: a struct holding its state ([`State`](ravenrs_reactive::State)
   fields, bindings, callbacks) with a `body()` that composes views. This is the
   SwiftUI-style building block and covers most needs.
3. **A [`View`]** implemented directly: full control over layout boxes,
   painting (including arbitrary [`Scene`](ravenrs_core::Scene) drawing through
   [`Paint::Custom`]), hit-testing, focus and click handling via [`BuildCx`].
   The built-in widgets are written this way, with no private API.

[`Canvas`] is the shortcut for custom drawing inside a normal layout.

# Features

* `decode` (default): PNG and JPEG decoding for [`Image::from_bytes`].
* `charts` (default): `Chart`, `BarChart`, `AreaChart` and `Barcode`. They draw
  the same charts and codes as reports, through `ravenrs-graphics`.

# Runtime

[`Ui`] owns the root view and turns it into a [`Scene`](ravenrs_core::Scene):
*build* (views to elements, tracked by a reactive observer), *layout* (Taffy),
*paint*. It only rebuilds when state the last build read has changed or the
interaction state (hover, press, focus) changed, and it never touches the GPU.

# Motion

A view declares how a node moves with [`BuildCx::motion`] and the runtime
plays it. While only animations run, frames repeat the paint phase alone, so
views are not rebuilt. When nothing moves, no frames are requested.

3126.name: Rule

5488.name: diagnostics_report_truncated

7450.name: weekdays

For weekly rules, the weekdays from Sunday to Saturday. With none chosen,
the first day's weekday.

4253.name: boolean
4253.docs: The answer for booleans, when the text is a yes/no word.

2691.name: Section

148.name: control_colors

9812.name: trap_focus

Keeps focus inside an open modal layer, moving it in when the layer

6288.name: is_open

Whether the sidebar is showing: its sheet in a narrow window, otherwise
the column at full width.

2764.name: event_calendar

6615.name: collapsible

Lets the caption fold the group. Reduced to icons, a group is always

548.name: Picture

948.name: hint

1275.name: DragPhase

A header or footer: laid out at full width, so closing only covers it, and
on the rail what fits between the rail's margins shows.

2656.name: delta
2656.docs: A change such as `"+12.4%"`; `up` picks the color and arrow.

2075.name: add_months

9777.name: handle_event
9777.docs: Feeds one input event; returns true when a redraw is needed.

3383.name: SPLASH_ICON_SIZE
3383.docs: The size of a [`SplashScreen`]'s icon, in logical pixels.

7234.name: width
7234.docs: Sets the width in logical pixels (220 by default).

4037.name: GridColumn
4037.docs: A data grid column: title, width, alignment, formatting and capabilities.

5345.name: label
5345.docs: The name screen readers announce for the group, such as "Density".

1821.name: on_drag
1821.docs: Receives pointer drags that start on the node (sliders, splitters...).

9196.name: font_size
9196.docs: Overrides the style's size; line height scales with it.

5672.name: underlay
5672.docs:
Paints the node's own shape behind all its siblings, so a moving marker
slides under the labels it crosses. The node must be a direct child of
the container holding those siblings.

9523.name: total_height
9523.docs: The whole height: the ruler and every track.

913.name: selected
913.docs: Marks the swatch as the current choice.

8288.name: OVERSCAN
8288.docs: Rows and ticks built beyond the edges, so a quick scroll shows no gap.

2221.name: start_test
2221.docs:
Opens the panel and redraws the window nonstop for a few seconds, to tell
the person in plain words how fast this machine draws this app.

5.name: ButtonStyle
5.docs: Visual emphasis of a [`Button`] or other control.

2621.name: tone
2621.docs: Sets the color tone and icon.

7453.name: every
7453.docs: Sets the interval; below 1 counts as 1.

9742.name: hover_chain
9742.docs: The hovered element and its ancestors.

9815.name: pinch
9815.docs:
Hands a zoom gesture to the topmost element under `p` that takes it. An
open modal layer keeps it from what is behind.

6291.name: narrow_below
6291.docs:
Below this window width, in logical pixels, it takes no room and opens
as a sheet over the page. It goes by the window, not by its container.

6618.name: DropdownMenu
6618.docs:
A button that opens a list of actions. The first item takes focus as the
menu opens; arrow keys move, Enter runs, Escape closes, and focus returns
to the button.

878.name: labels
878.docs:
The text of the two buttons and the word screen readers say before a
page number, for apps in other languages.

6037.name: paint_ghosts
6037.docs: Draws the exiting pictures of `layer` and forgets those that finished.

6364.name: side
6364.docs:
The window edge it belongs to ([`Side::Left`] by default). Place it on
that side of the page yourself; this sets its hairline, the side of its
tooltips and where its sheet comes from.

5456.name: ReleaseNotes

7745.name: Small
7745.docs: A row with a small icon and a label; three stack in a column.

697.name: AreaChart
697.docs:
A smooth area chart (sparkline style) of evenly spaced values.

Available with the `charts` feature, on by default.

5529.name: grid_summaries
5529.docs: Count, sum, average, smallest and largest, as a grid's footer calls them.

2005.name: Table
2005.docs: A simple data table with a header, hover-highlighted rows and numeric columns.

3640.name: new
3640.docs: A command labeled `label`; `action` runs when it is chosen.

8472.name: events
8472.docs: The bars. Those on no row are ignored.

5275.name: range
5275.docs: The value range; also resets the step to 1/100 of the range.

9780.name: access_tree
9780.docs:
The accessibility tree of the latest frame: roles, names, states and
frames of everything on screen, for screen readers. Call it after
[`Ui::update`]; platform layers send it to the operating system when it
changes. While a modal layer is open, only that layer is exposed.

4040.name: currency
4040.docs: A number column formatted as money: `currency("MRR", "R$ ", 2)`.

1170.name: new
1170.docs: A square-cornered quad with this fill, no border and no shadow.

1824.name: scroll_viewport
1824.docs:
The visible size of this widget's scroll container in the last layout,
or `None` before its first layout. Virtualized views use it with
[`Self::scroll_offset`] to build only the visible rows.

9199.name: foreground
9199.docs: Text color, as a theme role (`Ink` by default) or a literal color.

5675.name: exit
5675.docs:
When the node stops being built, its last picture stays on screen and
plays this effect. The picture takes no input and is hidden from
assistive technology: for the app, the node is already gone. Reopening
during the exit reverses it from where it is.

8291.name: subtitle
8291.docs: A second line under the name.

662.name: height
662.docs: Height of the bars in logical pixels, without their labels (default 180).

1316.name: fraction_x
1316.docs: Horizontal position inside the frame, from 0.0 (left) to 1.0 (right).

8691.name: dragging
8691.docs: It is the one a drag is moving, and this says if that place is allowed.

5494.name: month_year
5494.docs: Between a month and its year, such as `" "` or `" de "`.

7456.name: occurrences
7456.docs: The days of a rule starting at `start` that fall in `from..=to`, in order.

408.name: DrawFn
408.docs: Custom drawing callback: receives the element's absolute frame in logical pixels.

1389.name: Below
1389.docs: Below the anchor, left edges aligned.

5567.name: labels
5567.docs: The words the built-in components show or read aloud, in one place.

808.name: toggle_item
808.docs: The look shared by toggle buttons and toggle group items.

1789.name: ui_waker
1789.docs: A handle that asks for a rebuild from another thread; see [`UiWaker`](crate::UiWaker).

2770.name: new
2770.docs:
`month` holds the month shown (any day of it), so the app can load its
events; `selected` holds the day picked.

3097.name: InputOtp
3097.docs: Separate boxes for a one-time code; accepts digits by default.

1208.name: scale
1208.docs: Physical pixels per logical pixel, to make pictures that stay sharp.

627.name: spoken_values

5459.name: release_older

3243.name: HoverCard
3243.docs:
Rich content shown below a trigger while the pointer is over the trigger or
the card itself.

700.name: tone
700.docs: The line color role (Accent by default; Success, Danger...).

8729.name: Lanes
8729.docs: The empty part of the timeline: draws a new event, and holds the bars.

5532.name: month_title
5532.docs: A month and its year: `November 2026`, `novembro de 2026`.

3643.name: shortcut
3643.docs: Shows a shortcut hint, e.g. `"⌘S"` (display only).

4951.name: glyph
4951.docs: The character that draws this icon in the RavenIcons font.

8802.name: new
8802.docs: Children are a tuple of views (up to 12) or a `Vec`.

5278.name: label
5278.docs: The name screen readers announce, such as "Volume".

846.name: Roving
846.docs:
Roving focus for item `index` of `count` in a row or column (radio buttons,
tabs, toolbar buttons, menu items): arrow keys move focus to the neighbor,
wrapping; Home and End jump to the ends.

1827.name: now
1827.docs:
Seconds since the app started, as of this build. Reading it does not
schedule anything; use [`Self::wake_at`] to be rebuilt later.

3135.name: new
3135.docs: A field with this label above `content`.

4443.name: DataGrid

1573.name: measured_content
1573.docs: The size of the content of this view's measured node in the last layout.

2227.name: report

6878.name: open

2773.name: events_per_day
2773.docs: How many events show in a day before the rest become a count (3 by default).

9240.name: placeholder
9240.docs: Muted text shown while the value is empty.

6370.docs:
Shares whether it is open with a [`SidebarTrigger`] or the app. Without
this it starts open and keeps the state itself.

5462.name: diagnostics_test
5462.docs: The button that starts a performance test.

3900.name: Summary
3900.docs: An aggregate shown in group rows and in the footer.

8478.name: toolbar
8478.docs: The buttons to move through time and zoom (on by default).

every build, or give the motion a [`Motion::key`].

Top-left corner of an overlay of `size`, kept inside the viewport.
The scroll offset along one axis that shows `target` inside `view`, moving
as little as possible. A target larger than the view shows its start.

3138.name: error
3138.docs: The first error for the current value, if any.

4446.name: selection
4446.docs: Where the selected row indices live (otherwise the grid keeps them).

9278.name: Cursor
9278.docs:
Caret and selection of a text field, as char indices. The selection runs
from `anchor` to `caret`.

3211.name: ContextMenu
3211.docs: Opens a menu at the pointer on right click (or long press, planned) over its content.

5500.name: zoom_out
5500.docs: Zooms a scheduler's time axis out.

9351.name: index_at
9351.docs:
The char index nearest to `x` (relative to the text's left edge), given
the x position of every char boundary.

741.name: alt
741.docs: Describes the code for screen readers, in place of the text it holds.

1395.name: Fill

3357.docs:
The dimmed backdrop and sliding panel of a sheet. `bare` leaves out the title
row and the padding, for content that brings its own (a sidebar).

160.name: IconName
160.docs: Icons available to [`Icon`](crate::Icon), from the Lucide set.

814.name: single
814.docs: Exactly one item is on (like text alignment).

4992.name: Fit
4992.docs: Shows the whole image, letterboxed inside the frame (`contain`).

8843.name: spacing

8589.name: Preview
8589.docs: Where the event under a drag would land.

9243.name: width
9243.docs: Fixed width in logical pixels; by default the field stretches.

7681.docs:
Asking for a frame from another thread. Everything else in the runtime

8335.name: tone
8335.docs: Its color; say what it means in the title or next to the scheduler too.

5465.name: diagnostics_test_good
5465.docs: A performance test found the app fluid.

selection and the focus together (wrapping); Home and End jump to the ends.

7900.docs: A "Tell me what you want to do" search box.

8881.name: min

9862.name: label
9862.docs: A one-line label in the type scale.

4449.name: filter_row

9281.name: move_to
9281.docs: Moves the caret, extending the selection when `extend` is true.

5176.name: Checkbox

1798.docs: The pointer is over this view's interactive element.

innermost first, just far enough to show it with its focus ring. Returns
true if something scrolled, which makes the frames stale.

4087.name: model
4087.docs: Data grid data model: values, columns and the data source.

9246.name: on_cancel
9246.docs: Called when Escape is pressed while the field is focused.

after its duration or when closed.

7357.name: Weekly
7357.docs: Every `interval` weeks, on the chosen weekdays.

8992.name: breakpoint
8992.docs:

(default 640).

5468.name: diagnostics_test_fps
5468.docs: After the rate a performance test measured.

and the keyboard. Add `on_click` to it.

Width of a sidebar reduced to icons, in logical pixels. It keeps each icon
where it was when the sidebar is open: padding, row padding, icon, and back.

A row in a menu or select list. `on_click` runs after `close`. Rows take
focus as the list opens, and arrow keys move between them.

Takes a share of the free space in the parent stack. A growing
stack may also shrink below its content (CSS `min-height: 0`), so
scroll views inside it get a bounded height.

5614.docs: Fixes the width and/or height in logical pixels; `None` keeps the content size.

What a [`View`] uses to describe itself during a build: theme access,
interaction state, child building, layout boxes, painting and behavior.

4052.name: template
4052.docs: Custom view for each cell (a badge, an avatar...).

1836.name: on_context_menu
1836.docs: Calls `handler` with the pointer position on a secondary (right) click.

8957.name: spacing
8957.docs: Gap between cells, in logical pixels (default 16).

2890.name: required

5506.name: recurrence_ends_name

9103.name: width

buttons should always have one.

1801.name: is_pressed
1801.docs: The primary button went down on this view and has not been released.

5652.name: grow
5652.docs: Takes a share of the free space in the parent stack.

6960.name: overlay
6960.docs: Floating layers: tooltips, popovers, menus, selects and dialogs.

7614.name: ReleaseNote
7614.docs: What one version brought, for a [`ReleaseNotes`].

a wide canvas). Children keep their own width instead of stretching.

7360.name: ALL
7360.docs: Every frequency, in the order an editor offers them.

8995.name: Text
8995.docs: Text in the theme's type scale. It wraps to the width its container offers.

5471.name: diagnostics_test_cause_interface
5471.docs: A performance test blames building the screen.

9322.name: word_start
9322.docs: The start of the word before `at` (Alt/Ctrl+Left).

8414.name: id
8414.docs: The event; for one being created, `None`.

1693.name: viewports
1693.docs: Frame size of each scroll container in the last layout.

9068.name: right
9068.docs: The views at the right end.

7506.name: recurrence
7506.docs: How something repeats: a rule, with no UI, that answers on which days.

458.name: corner_radius

7833.name: new
7833.docs: An empty group with this caption.

column title. Any other text, such as `[draft]`, stays a short filter, and so does anything a
row cannot answer on its own: aggregates, parameters and functions the grid does not register.

5617.name: max_width
5617.docs: Caps the width in logical pixels.

4055.name: display_cow
4055.docs: [`GridColumn::display`] without copying text that is shown as stored.

reports; here its shapes become a picture and its labels become text. Both are
kept between frames, so a rebuild that changes nothing uploads nothing.

1839.name: modifiers

Keyboard modifiers as of the latest input event, readable from click
handlers (e.g. Shift-click to extend a selection).

7652.name: new
7652.docs: The versions in `notes`, newest first, on the one at `selected`.

4128.name: search

8633.name: follow

2893.name: validate

350.name: today

9033.name: FooterArea

5509.name: recurrence_until
5509.docs: Before the last day, in words.

7798.name: large
7798.docs: Shows the item as a large button.

169.name: size

7544.name: CodeBlock

button that puts it on the clipboard.

8198.name: months
8198.docs: `count` months from the month of `from`, a tick per month.

1477.name: semantics
1477.docs: Describes the node to screen readers; see [`Semantics`].

1804.name: child
1804.docs:

view's children.

9833.name: anchor_of

4093.name: set_cell
4093.docs: Replaces one cell; out-of-range indices are ignored.

5074.name: content_mode

8925.name: height

315.name: KeyHandler

8344.name: resizable
8344.docs: Whether its length can change (on by default). It can still be moved.

5474.docs: Diagnostics: the app was built without optimizations.

nothing was selected.

1769.docs: What the parts of a sidebar need to know about the sidebar around them.

5620.name: centered

handling events and before each frame. Animations start only once a
platform drives this clock.

(a hidden window, a slow frame) they continue about where they were
instead of jumping to the end.

207.name: on_click

4058.name: parse
4058.docs: Parses edited text into a value of this column's kind.

4385.name: to_csv
4385.docs: Matching rows as CSV (RFC 4180), visible columns only, in display order.

4712.name: Icon
4712.docs:
A vector icon from the built-in Lucide set, drawn as a glyph so it stays
crisp at any size and takes the text color.

1842.name: scroll_horizontally

5112.name: placement

2896.name: extras

shapes are drawn into a picture at the screen's density, and the labels are
real text.

Available with the `charts` feature, on by default.

```
use ravenrs_widgets::{Chart, ChartKind};

let sales = Chart::new(ChartKind::Line)
    .title("Sales")
    .categories(["Jan", "Feb", "Mar"])
    .series("2025", [12.0, 18.0, 15.0])
    .series("2026", [14.0, 21.0, 26.0])
    .height(240.0);
```
